title: Hotels
body:
Official Hotel Room Blocks

We've negotiated discount rates with three hotels close to the Asia World-Expo and Hong Kong Airport. Please move quickly to reserve a room before they sell out!

  • Sky City Marriott (Hotel attached to Summit venue, Asia World-Expo) SOLD OUT!
  • Regal Airport Hotel 
  • Novotel Citygate (Enter OPSTK as the Preferential Code to access the room block) SOLD OUT!

Other Budget-Friendly Recommendations

In addition to the official room blocks, we've identified several budget-friendly hotels with average rates of $150 USD or less. We will NOT secure room blocks with these hotels, but they may be great options for your stay in Hong Kong. Please note the Airport Express train stops at Asia World Expo, making it convenient to access the convention center from most parts of the city by a 25-minute train ride.

For details on the pricing, location, breakfast, wifi, and travel time for each hotel, please see the Budget Hotel Guide (PDF File).

  • Hotel ibis Hong Kong Sheung Wan
  • Best Western - Harbour View
  • Rambler Oasis Hotel
  • Best Western Grand Hotel
  • Ramada Hotel Kowloon
